results.overview: When Norman, an aspiring actor, can't find an open door in Hollywood he gets rather dispirited. But he gets a new lease on life when he discovers an invisibility formula and learns that women don't really care whether they can see him or not! This erotic comedy is based on the comic books by Milo Manera.

results.title: I Made The Invisible Man

results.overview: The journey of a someone in search of his roots. He is pursued by his childhood self who has already written his own future, and foretells the amnesia which will doom this traveling. Here is a life made of pictures, an allegory and reflection of life inside ‘the society of the spectacle.’
results.title: The Invisible Man

results.overview: Shunned and ignored for years by society in general, a lonely man develops a new ability, product of his own limitations: his ugliness, filthiness and poverty render him literally invisible from everyone else's gaze. Incited by his newfound power, the lonely man will begin to explore all the possibilities his new talent brings.
results.title: The New Invisible Man

results.overview: The Invisible Man, on the run from the law, inadvertently impersonates the ghost of Darla's recently dead grandma in order not to get caught.
results.title: LOOK! The Invisible Man

results.overview: A group of homeless aliens begin to migrate illegally to a small town on Earth. A young guy Wang Ergou with invisible powers is supposed to stop the invasion, but instead he is mistaken for an alien. An evil biologist kidnaps the hero and begins experimenting on him. When the aliens decipher Wang's invisibility, they send Brain, an experienced retired general and an alien with invisible superpowers, to challenge him.
results.title: The Invisible Man

results.overview: A fugitive, dangerous madman reaches an English village where he confronts his former partner who left him for dead in the jungle after their discovery of a diamond mine. When the former partner also claims to have since lost the mine and all its wealth, which he took all for himself, and though the partner is still living in a state of luxury , the madman takes up an offer from a crazed scientist to make him invisible, something the scientist has already done with experimental animals, so that he can take revenge.
results.title: The Invisible Man's Revenge
